result:
I've planned round 432: **SABA-B-12 stage 2b**, which replaces Chromium's default progress bar in the Export dialog with one drawn by the theme. The decision is **CONTINUE**, written to `b-next.json` and `b-round-431.md`.

**Round 431 is closed on evidence, not on C's word.** I re-ran the L57 check (OK) and re-judged C's own probe files: ALL OK for the radios and EXTRA ALL OK for forced colours and export. C's mutant results match mine, and the two auth retries pass (the first attempt was a cold-server error, not a bypass). Gate 431 published `1197dcb` on both remotes; that commit is the baseline for round 432. STUDIO-VIS-2 is done.

**What round 432 changes.** Today, while a WAV export renders, the bar is Chromium's green fill on grey; while the MP3 encoder loads, it is a flat grey bar. I confirmed both in a real browser at HEAD.
- **Look:** a graphite track with a cream fill and rounded ends, at the same 494×8 size. The fill stays neutral rather than brass, keeping an earlier colour-role decision. All of this comes from one shared class in a new `studio-progress.ts`.
- **While the encoder loads:** a dimmed full bar that pulses, and stays still when the user prefers reduced motion.
- **Forced colours:** the system bar comes back.
- **Who decided:** the product-designer chose this look, and the tech-lead approved with minor notes. I applied two of them: a Firefox fill for the loading state and a stricter test scan.

**My checks on the final sketch:**
- **Browser, both viewports:** the sketch passes all four bar states and HEAD fails, so the check catches the difference. Label, accessible name and box size are unchanged from HEAD. Both the MP3 and the WAV still download.
- **Tests:** all 8 deliberate breakages are caught by the new tests; the 30 covering test files pass (386 tests); the full suite passes on the sketch (270 files, 4,006 tests).
- **Static checks:** typecheck, lint and Biome pass.
- **Ableton manual:** sections 5.1.3.5 and 5.1.3.4 confirm Live shows a progress bar in the export dialog and resets it for each pass, as ours does between phases. I had first drafted a question for Saba based on a search summary; I withdrew it once the manual answered it.
- **Known limits:** only Chromium runs in the cloud. Firefox, Safari and a real Windows High Contrast check stay on the Tech Lead list (deadline RETRO 435). In emulated forced colours the bar draws all white both before and after this change, so I recorded that rather than testing for it.

**Things to fix outside the loop:**
- **Backlog tool bug.** `cloud/optimize-backlog.py` archives any finding whose status contains the word "done" anywhere. That moved the open Medium SABA-B-12 into the archive. I restored it and filed ROOT-REQ-OPTIMIZER-STATUS-SUBSTRING; a scan found no other open item affected.
- **Architecture checkpoint.** The radio and progress rounds raised the idea of merging the per-control `studio-*.ts` class files. I recorded it as a signal and asked root for one bounded frontend-architect checkpoint after stage 3; it doesn't block anything.
- **Stale workflow file.** `agent-workflow.md` on disk ends at the Loop v2 section, older than the snapshot in my instructions. I followed the snapshot and found no newer entries and no STEM-LANES answer.

**Records and next round:**
- **Backlog:** now v414 (decisions D-29z1521–D-29z1526). Four new Lows go to the polish list: three test-regex limits from A's reviewer and one from the gate review. A fifth Low is my own: two visible "Loading … encoder" lines during the MP3 load.
- **Next:** round 433 is the regression round if planning falls on or after 2026-11-13; otherwise stage 3, the search clear button in the shortcut sheet.

**Files written:** `current-task.md` (round 431's task kept as `tasks/round-431.md`), `backlog.json`, `feature-status.md`, `b-round-431.md`, `b-next.json`. Supporting evidence is in `b-round-431/`. The store tree is clean at `1197dcb`, and the temporary sketch server is stopped. The advisor was available and consulted twice.

Sources:
- [Ableton Live 12 manual – Managing Files and Sets (5.1.3)](https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/managing-files-and-sets/)
- [Ableton Live 12 Beta Release Notes](https://www.ableton.com/en/release-notes/live-12-beta/) (too large to open; not used)
- [How to Export Audio and Video in Ableton Live](https://iconcollective.edu/export-audio-in-ableton-live) (search result only)
